penalties_applied.name: requires_human_fulfillment
penalties_applied.reason: Identity-stitching middleware for Salesforce Data Cloud requires bespoke implementation per client's domain portfolio, SDK version, and consent architecture — not automatable delivery.

penalties_applied.name: requires_synchronous_human
penalties_applied.reason: Martech architects at mid-to-large companies will require discovery, scoping, and onboarding calls before any implementation; async self-serve is not viable at this complexity level.

rationale: The buyer is real — marketing engineers at companies managing 14+ domains with live paid media budgets — and the pain costs actual ad spend. But the solution is a deep integration problem tied to Salesforce's SDK internals, cross-domain cookie behavior, and consent management architecture; it cannot be packaged as a generic automated service a Claude factory builds and delivers hands-off. Operational autonomy (3) and buildability with AI (3) both fail their build-gate floors hard, and after penalties the total drops to 2.4. This is a specialist consulting engagement.
solution_plan: A solo non-technical operator cannot build or maintain this. Resolving cross-domain deviceId resets in Salesforce Data Cloud SDK requires platform-specific debugging, client org access, and martech architecture knowledge that Claude cannot substitute for. Dropping is correct.
notes: Fails operational_autonomy_min (3 < 7), buildability_with_ai_min (3 < 6). Total also falls below min_total_to_validate after penalties.
